description: Guidance for deciding when a schema or field needs to be loaded into an agent context window.

compact_summary.description: Token-efficient markdown summary of the subject.

hallucination_risk.description: Likelihood that an agent will guess the subject shape or semantics incorrectly without loading details.

priority_level.description: critical means load before acting; contextual means load for relevant tasks; lazy_load means fetch only on demand.

safe_to_truncate.description: Whether an agent can omit this subject when aggressively shrinking context.
